spec.name: OHLC Stochastic
spec.entry_long: crossabove(10 * (close - donchian_low(low,10)) / (donchian_high(high,95.0) - donchian_low(low,2)), sma(95.0 * (close - donchian_low(low,5)) / (donchian_high(high,5) - donchian_low(low,5)),3)) and (100 * (close - donchian_low(low,5)) / (donchian_high(high,5) - donchian_low(low,5)) < 30 or sma(100 * (close - donchian_low(low,5)) / (donchian_high(high,5) - donchian_low(low,5)),3) < 30)
spec.exit_long: crossbelow(100 * (close - donchian_low(low,5)) / (donchian_high(high,5) - donchian_low(low,5)), sma(100 * (close - donchian_low(low,5)) / (donchian_high(high,5) - donchian_low(low,5)),3)) and (100 * (close - donchian_low(low,5)) / (donchian_high(high,5) - donchian_low(low,5)) > 70 or sma(100 * (close - donchian_low(low,5)) / (donchian_high(high,5) - donchian_low(low,5)),3) > 70)
spec.notes: Documented values are used: %K is the 5-bar range position (KPeriod 5), %D its 3-bar SMA (DPeriod 3, Slowing 3), and the long requires the cross above with at least one line under LevelDown 30. Protection is a trailing stop in price steps (5/2) which cannot be a fixed percentage, so the mirrored LevelUp 70 reversal closes the position; the 12-hour CandleType and reversal sizing are not selectable.
